name: alerts-03
description: A table of alert rules with their conditions, severities and channels, and a switch to pause or resume each one.

files.content:
'use client' import { type AlertSeverity, SeverityLabel, formatRelativeTime, } from '@/registry/components/dashboardblocks/alerts' import { BlockReady, BlockStateProvider, type BlockStatus, getBlockState, } from '@/registry/components/dashboardblocks/block-state' import { DataTable, DataTableBody, DataTableCell, DataTableHead, DataTableHeader, DataTableRow, DataTableStateRows, } from '@/registry/components/dashboardblocks/data-table' import { useState } from 'react' import { Switch } from '@/components/ui/switch' interface AlertRule { channels: string[] condition: string enabled: boolean id: string lastTriggered?: Date name: string severity: AlertSeverity } interface Alerts3Props { /** Defaults to a sentence counting the active rules and the last one to fire. */ description?: string now: Date onEnabledChange?: (id: string, enabled: boolean) => void /** Leave out, or pass none, to show the empty state. */ rules?: AlertRule[] status?: BlockStatus title: string } const NOW = Date.UTC(2026, 8, 25, 14, 30) const hoursAgo = (hours: number) => new Date(NOW - hours * 3_600_000) const exampleProps: Alerts3Props = { now: new Date(NOW), rules: [ { channels: ['PagerDuty', 'Slack'], condition: 'Error rate > 5% for 5 min', enabled: true, id: 'r1', lastTriggered: hoursAgo(0.1), name: 'API errors', severity: 'critical', }, { channels: ['Slack'], condition: 'p95 latency > 800 ms for 10 min', enabled: true, id: 'r2', lastTriggered: hoursAgo(0.9), name: 'Slow search', severity: 'warning', }, { channels: ['Email'], condition: 'Disk usage > 80%', enabled: true, id: 'r3', lastTriggered: hoursAgo(26), name: 'Database disk', severity: 'warning', }, { channels: ['Slack', 'Email'], condition: 'Daily signups < 50% of 7-day average', enabled: false, id: 'r4', name: 'Signup drop', severity: 'info', }, ], title: 'Alert rules', } const summarize = (rules: AlertRule[], active: number, now: Date) => { const fired = rules .filter((rule) => rule.lastTriggered) .sort( (a, b) => (b.lastTriggered?.getTime() ?? 0) - (a.lastTriggered?.getTime() ?? 0), )[0] const count = `${active} of ${rules.length} rules active.` if (!fired?.lastTriggered) return count return `${count} ${fired.name} fired last, ${formatRelativeTime(fired.lastTriggered, now)}.` } const Alerts3 = (props: Alerts3Props) => { const { now, onEnabledChange, rules = [], status, title } = props const [enabled, setEnabled] = useState>(() => new Map()) const state = getBlockState(status, rules) const isEnabled = (rule: AlertRule) => enabled.get(rule.id) ?? rule.enabled const active = rules.filter(isEnabled).length const { description = summarize(rules, active, now) } = props return (

{title}

{description}

{title} Rule Severity Notifies Last triggered Status {!state && rules.map((rule) => { const ruleEnabled = isEnabled(rule) return ( {rule.name} {rule.condition} {rule.channels.join(', ')} {rule.lastTriggered ? ( {formatRelativeTime(rule.lastTriggered, now)} ) : ( 'Never' )}
{ setEnabled((current) => new Map(current).set(rule.id, checked), ) onEnabledChange?.(rule.id, checked) }} /> {ruleEnabled ? 'Active' : 'Paused'}
) })}
) } export { Alerts3, exampleProps as alerts3ExampleProps, type Alerts3Props }
